# VOUT Retail · Cloud POS & Store Management Engine
> High-throughput Cloud Point of Sale, multi-store inventory audits, and blind cash drawer shifts.

## Overview
VOUT Retail is an enterprise-grade retail store engine designed for physical store velocity. Built with Next.js 16, React 19, and Neon Serverless PostgreSQL.

## Core Capabilities
- Barcode scanner checkout with instant SKU lookups (<10ms)
- Blind cash drawer shifts with automated discrepancy reporting
- Thermal receipt printing (80mm standard ESC/POS format)
- Atomic multi-item sales transactions with stock deduction
- Customer credit ledger and debtor payment schedules

## Live Demo & Endpoints
- Production Live URL: https://milesi-erp.vercel.app
- 1-Click Guest Access: https://milesi-erp.vercel.app/demo
- POS Terminal: https://milesi-erp.vercel.app/pos
- Source Code: https://github.com/AgustinMilesi/retail

## Technical Stack
- Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack) + React 19
- Tailwind CSS v4 + TypeScript 5
- Prisma ORM 6 on Neon Serverless PostgreSQL
- Creator: Agustín Milesi (https://github.com/AgustinMilesi)
